display.purpose: Section-defining serif titles and hero serif figures (20–22px).

headline.purpose: Serif page titles (Dashboard, Pipeline, Payments, Calendar).

figure.purpose: KPI numbers on stat cards; always tabular numerals.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows, column headers, nav group labels.

motion.name: ease-house
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every animated surface (from @/lib/motion).

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: Card / row entrance (12px rise + fade, staggered 0.04–0.08s).

motion.name: duration-grow
motion.purpose: Bar and band growth on charts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single pine action per toolbar — add deal, send invoice, save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: #0E7A5F; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0B664F; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(14,122,95,.3); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #57504A; border: 1px solid #E8E3DB; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: #1B1815; background: #FBFAF7; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(14,122,95,.3); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Tone-mapped status pill: tint background, deep foreground; live deals add a pulsing pine dot.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #E4F1EB; color: #0E7A5F; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0E7A5F; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: The KPI unit: uppercase eyebrow, tabular count-up figure, delta chip, caption.
components.css: .ds-statcard { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 220px; padding: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E8E3DB; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,24,21,.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-statcard:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(27,24,21,.08), 0 1px 3px rgba(27,24,21,.06); } .ds-statcard-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #757069; } .ds-statcard-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-statcard-figure { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #1B1815; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-statcard-delta { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #E4F1EB; color: #0E7A5F; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-statcard-context { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: #757069; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field: hairline border sharpening to pine on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1B1815; border: 1px solid #E8E3DB; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #757069; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0E7A5F; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar entry: pine-tint fill + pine text when active; text warms on hover.
components.html: DashboardPipeline
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 200px; padding: 8px; background: #F7F5F1; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: #57504A; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #1B1815; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(14,122,95,.3); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #E4F1EB; color: #0E7A5F; } .ds-nav-item-active:hover { color: #0B664F; }

narrative.overview: Sponsee looks like a well-kept ledger on warm paper: a calm, professional back office for one person managing real money. Every neutral carries a warm cast — the background is paper, not gray; text is ink, not black; borders are hairlines the color of aged paper. Against that quiet ground, a single deep pine green does all the interactive work, and money is always set in tabular figures. The system is deliberately the opposite of streamer-tool convention: no dark mode by default, no neon, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no gamer RGB — those read as the platforms the creator streams on, not the business that pays their rent. Platform identity is confined to tiny dots and chips, the way a paper planner uses colored stickers.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals everywhere; zero pure grays or pure black.
One interactive accent (deep pine); amber and brick reserved for attention and danger.
Serif display type over sans body — an editorial, professional-assistant voice.
Financial figures are semibold, tabular, and tightly tracked.
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; warm shadows appear on hover and overlays only.

rules.name: The Warm Cast Rule
rules.body: No pure gray, no pure black, anywhere. Every neutral comes from the paper/ink ramp; a #EEE border or #333 text is a defect.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Pine is the only color that means interactive. Amber and brick are statuses, never buttons or links. If a screen looks colorful, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Sticker Rule
rules.body: Platform brand colors appear only as small dots and chips (≤8px dots), never as surface, text, or button colors.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Display Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears only in page titles and hero figures. Serif body text or serif UI controls are defects.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every financial figure takes tabular numerals. Proportional digits in a money column are a defect.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Depth is a response to interaction or layering, never decoration. No shadow beyond the resting warm shadow on static elements.

rules.name: The One Curve Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second easing curve or ad-hoc duration; import from @/lib/motion.

dos: Do use pine (#0E7A5F) for every interactive affordance and only for interactive affordances or positive status.
Do set every financial figure in tabular numerals, right-aligned in columns.
Do pair every chip tone as tint background + deep foreground.
Do keep serif type to page titles and hero figures at 19–22px.
Do import easing, durations, and stagger from @/lib/motion for any animation.
Do give every focusable element a visible pine focus ring.
donts: Don't introduce pure grays, pure black, gradients, glassmorphism, dark-neon, or any gamer-RGB styling.
Don't use platform brand colors beyond small dots and chips; never render TikTok in neon cyan/magenta.
Don't add fonts beyond Inter, Instrument Serif, and JetBrains Mono, or load fonts from a CDN.
Don't exceed 14px corner radius on in-app containers (the standalone auth card's 16px is the only exception) or use sharp corners; pills are for chips only.
Don't put shadows on static decoration or use cool-toned shadows.
Don't use amber or brick as button or link colors; they are status signals only.
